name: Your Affliction, Lester Diaz
source:
You've started a brand new job as an office receptionist.

It's too bad you can't escape him. 

Your new coworker.

Lester Diaz.

 A strange man with an intense staring problem. 

A man who seemed all too interested in you the moment he saw you.

And you can't decide whether you're flattered or horrified with each passing day as you discover how he is around your desk behind closed doors.

Do you feel disgust? Or pity? 

Will he end up dead by your hands? Or will you end become his beloved pet?

His lover?

Or maybe his...dinner?

[From [url=https://p1nk-ang3l.itch.io/your-affliction-lester-diaz]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经开始了一份全新的办公室接待员工作。

可惜你无法逃离他。

你的新同事。

莱斯特·迪亚兹.

 一个有强烈凝视问题的奇怪男人。

一个一看到你就对你非常感兴趣的男人。

当你发现他关起门来坐在你的办公桌旁时，你无法决定你是感到受宠若惊还是感到震惊。

你感到厌恶吗？还是怜悯？

他最后会死在你手里吗？或者你最终会成为他心爱的宠物吗？

他的爱人？

或者也许是他的……晚餐？
